product_one_liner.value: CoLab provides AI-powered collaborative design-review software for mechanical engineering and hardware-development teams, helping them review CAD and engineering designs and capture and apply expert knowledge.
product_one_liner.notes: CoLab describes its AI-powered collaborative engineering platform for mechanical engineering and hardware teams, and explains that it hosts design reviews and captures the rationale behind changes.

pricing_page.notes: The company’s /pricing URL resolves to a page offering only “get a demo” contact links rather than public plans or prices, so it is not a public pricing page under the stated rule.
